question: Can a low-turnover long US500 equity-risk-premium component reduce drawdown by scaling exposure with prior-session VIX while retaining positive net expectancy for 200-500 USDC at Ostium?
economic_mechanism: Equity risk premium supplies the return source; volatility is a risk state, not an entry-direction predictor. Exposure falls when option-implied uncertainty rises because volatility changes need not be matched by proportional changes in expected return.

rule.decision_frequency: weekly, first tradable US500 session of the week
rule.information_lag: use only the latest official VIX close published before the US500 decision session

baselines: always-long US500 at 1.0 exposure with the same weekly execution convention and costs

cost_contract.source: US500 Ostium execution gate through 2026-08-13 open; one complete day only
cost_contract.stress: max(2 * measured median, measured p95) plus reconciled weekly rollover

data_contract.spy_source: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint, SPY daily OHLC plus adjusted close, requested only through 2019-12-31
data_contract.vix_source: Cboe official VIX daily prices CSV
data_contract.price_convention: first SPY session adjusted open of each ISO week; open is adjusted by adjusted_close divided by close
data_contract.vix_convention: latest official VIX close strictly before the SPY decision date
data_contract.raw_storage: temporary only; persist source locators and SHA-256 hashes, not redistributed raw history
data_contract.sq_boundary_tested: SQCLI build 143.2708 refused export because licensed SQ Equities/Futures Data cannot be used outside StrategyQuant
data_contract.sealed_holdout_protection: the SPY request ends at 2019-12-31 and the evaluator emits holdout_accessed=false

development: maximum drawdown at least 15 percent lower than equal-cost always-long baseline
net return divided by maximum drawdown greater than baseline
positive net result in at least 6 of 8 years
validation: maximum drawdown lower than equal-cost always-long baseline
net return divided by maximum drawdown not below 80 percent of development
positive net result in at least 3 of 5 years
modern_oos: no liquidation at a separately selected small-account leverage
benefit is not confined to the 2020 crash rebound
small_account_economics: report CAGR and net USDC for starting balances of 200 and 500 USDC
report 1x, 2x, 3x and 5x only after edge validation; never select leverage by highest hindsight profit
select the highest fixed ladder leverage whose stressed maximum drawdown remains at or below 25 percent; 25-35 percent is paper-only and above 35 percent is rejected
estimated probability of ruin must remain below 1 percent under block bootstrap and stressed execution
liquidation buffer must be explicit and must not depend on adding collateral
annualized net gain must be at least 10 percent or the component is economically immaterial for the portfolio objective
report probability and time-to-2x by bootstrap; do not call 2x feasible from CAGR alone

automatic_reject: requires tuning the VIX numerator or rebalance day after seeing results
only improves Sharpe by suppressing nearly all exposure
weekly turnover and rollover erase the development tendency
depends on accessing the sealed 2024-2026 holdout
difference_from_rejected_families: This is exposure management of a persistent equity premium, not an M15 timing pattern, turn-of-month rule or VIX term-structure transition.
